college_identity.verified_name: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology, Nagpur
college_identity.identity_notes: Formerly Visvesvaraya Regional College of Engineering (VRCE), established 1960; granted Deemed University status in 2002; declared Institute of National Importance in 2007 under the NIT Act. Named after engineer-statesman Sir M. Visvesvaraya. Single main campus (~214-220 acres depending on source) on South Ambazari Road, Nagpur, near Ambazari Lake. Verified distinct from IIIT Nagpur (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Nagpur), a separate private institution also located in Nagpur that appeared in adjacent Careers360 listing results — no evidence from IIIT Nagpur was included in this extraction.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'In VNIT the students are eligible to sit for campus placements after 4th semester, that is from 3rd year, and there are many companies which visit VNIT Nagpur such as Deloitte, Google, Amazon, Accenture and many more. The placement percentage of last year is 77.59% with highest package of 64 LPA and average package of 11.57 LPA.'
'I liked the location of college, it is based in IT Park of Nagpur which is very prime location.'
'The mentorship is also good, we get 3rd year mentors for 2 years and they guide us till the end of 2nd year.'
'Faculty are much experienced in their field, that was the best part of the electrical engineering department.'

'The overall percentage of students placed was 83-85%. Talking about department-wise placement, there was 93.5% placement for mechanical department, 88% for chemical dept, 92% for ECE and EEE department.'
'First year boy hostel end time is 8 pm which is somewhat disappointing.'

'This new syllabus [is] designed for core metallurgy and materials; if you perform well in first year then you can take a minor subject which is an extra advantage, but you have to maintain good CGPA in both, otherwise you have to leave the subject or extend your degree time.' Descriptive of a policy/structure rather than clearly valenced praise or complaint.

review_items.review_title: Review of VNIT Nagpur - Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The placement process was good. The placement cell was good and provided good job opportunities... Companies that visited the college were TCS, Tata, Infosys, Infotech, HCL, Cipla, Lotus, and many more. Around 90% of students were placed every year. The highest package ranged from 25-35 LPA. The average package ranged from 4-7 LPA.'
'My hostel was very good, with nice facilities, and the food was also very good. Food was provided according to the menu and was hygienic.'

review_items.review_title: VNIT Nagpur- the man, the myth, the legend

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The percentage of students placed is overall 86%, while in our branch it is 93%. The highest package is 64 LPA offered by Oracle to 9 students. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 17 LPA. The top companies recruiting are Oracle, Google, DE Shaw, and JP Morgan. About 60% of students receive internships.'

'The infrastructure here is quite decent. There are old buildings dating back to 1980, and also newer buildings. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, except at hostels, where we have a LAN with good speed. There is a well-equipped international-level library.'
'We have three messes. The food is above expectations, but is repetitive. It has one of the best sports facilities among all NITs.'

'Typical government hostel, gets cleaned every day. LAN connection is available for all the students. The mess food is average, like you can survive on the food, except on Sunday night.' Descriptive/lukewarm rather than strongly positive or negative.
'A health centre is available on campus itself, and an ambulance is also available. Good enthusiasm for sports also.'

'VNIT Nagpur has good faculty. All the faculty members are well-educated and hold degrees like PhD. The faculty at VNIT Nagpur is helpful and aim to make the educational experience better for all the students.'

'Mechanical dept at VNIT has solid faculty, qualified, and some are from there, though teaching quality varies. The curriculum is strong, with labs, projects, and industry visits making you job ready in core fields.'
'College Infrastructure & Hostel Facilities: Food is very poor and classroom infrastructure is also very poor and is not up to the mark.'

'Society of VNIT is good because of the greenery of VNIT. Students of different parts of India come together where there is no culture difference and in languages too. They live together in a room, they know each other as Indian.'

'There are a lot of high profile companies visiting the campus for hiring purposes which include Amazon, DirectI, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan Chase, Siemens, HeroMoto Corp, Mercedes, Reliance, Coal India, JSW Steel etc. The highest amount of package is INR 22 lakhs offered by Goldman Sachs.' Reviewer specifically references the score needed to get into CSE branch (190-200 in JEE Main), indicating this review is CSE-scoped.
'One can enjoy a lot from this VNIT if you are equally interested in academics as well as extra activities.'
'Many core companies such as TATA, Coal India, NYC, L&T etc. come to Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology, VNIT Nagpur and offer good packages to the students.'
'Academics are good at VNIT Nagpur, the quality of teaching is very good and faculty is very supportive.'
'There are lot many scholarships that one can avail from government or private sources. Every year around 20 students get funding from alumni association.'
